name: whirlwind of sand
desc: the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} remain in its possession.
